source_of_truth: Existing Supabase BOOM tables in project boom-social-world

tables.mapping: mission/workflow/run/correlation lineage stored in members/evidence; status and Owner Gate state persisted
material workflow Owner Gate proposals and approved/rejected decisions
testing-only learning proposals; no automatic behavior adoption

access.browser: Owner/Admin through BoomRuntime and existing RLS
access.service_role: Server-side Edge Functions only; never browser
access.n8n: Indirect only through boom-automation-gateway; never direct database authority

invariants: No new ledger tables are introduced for Automation Control Plane V1.
mission_id, workflow_id, run_id and correlation_id are preserved in durable evidence.
Material actions remain suppressed in SHADOW even after a SHADOW approval decision.
Approval decisions are recorded in hunt_boom_decisions and never grant n8n authority.
Runtime and event payloads are sanitized before persistence.
No raw credentials, email, phone, address or payment data in automation evidence.
